title: School-Live!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Cheerful Yuki Takeya thinks she lives at school as part of a fun club, but the cute surface hides a zombie outbreak her mind refuses to see. Her friends in the School Living Club, the only survivors at their school, play along to protect her while scavenging and fighting off the infected. Later they leave for a university where rival survivor groups and clues about the infection test them further.
life_message: It holds up keeping hope, routine and each other alive when the world has ended.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: No honor contests; the girls cooperate and protect each other quietly.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Strict club routines and school rules keep everyone sane and alive.

Civic vs kin.evidence: The club becomes a family; outsiders at the university are trusted cautiously.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Club president and teacher lead, but decisions are largely shared.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: School rituals matter, but a scientific cure is the hope.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Food, safety and survival dominate every choice.

folkways.japan: School as a second home, club-activity rituals and the cute-girls 'Kirara' style subverted by horror draw on Japanese school culture.

delivery.evidence: Cute surface over a zombie outbreak (AniList Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Post-Apocalyptic); no source comments on delivery (to verify)
delivery.note: Hope and care are shown through the club's routines, set against violent rival survivors.

winners_losers: Compassionate, cooperative survivors win; the violent Militants lose. Sympathy goes to care and honest grief.
